comment: Each case builds a small repository with a known story, then checks what the model makes of it. The stories are the ones that matter: a plain reason, a revert, a reapplied change, and histories where the reason is simply not written down.

commits.message: Raise the timeout to 30s because clients on mobile networks were being cut off mid-upload

cases.name: revert with the reason in the revert

commits.message:
Revert "Retry failed token fetches"

The retry had no limit, so when the endpoint was down it looped forever and pinned a CPU.
Trim the input before parsing, because trailing newlines from the CLI broke the parser
Simplify: the trim should not be needed
Put the trim back, the CLI really does send a trailing newline
